svg.text: en_ctrl_3v3 (v2): fail-safe enable and select bits for the 3.3 V circuits of slot 7 and its pads
en_3v3 = en_1v2 at 3.3 V, en_3v3_b = NOT en_3v3 (XE). sel0_3v3 / sel1_3v3 = sel0_1v2 / sel1_1v2 at 3.3 V
(XS0, XS1), gated by en_3v3 downstream; sel0_b, sel1_b are not used.
Each bit is one ls_up_fs, shifted without a 1.2 V supply: the inputs are valid 1.2 V levels from the harness
always-on rail (enable, dig_in), also while the slot vdd_1v2 is off.
vddh / vss: the slot switched vdd_3v3 / vss_3v3; the cell is unpowered with it. No supply sensing.
Static current: the leaker of each ls_up_fs whose input is 1. Source: netlist/source/en_ctrl_3v3.spice
